action.new_text:
def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validation
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
    for arr in (logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call):
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("All input arrays must be 2D")
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if not (logp_call_only.shape == shape and logp_no_call.shape == shape):
        raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")
    if shape[0] == 0 or shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input arrays must not be empty")
    for arr in (logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call):
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError("All input arrays must be finite")
        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
            raise ValueError("All input arrays must be nonpositive")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    n_candidates, horizon = shape
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw_weights / np.sum(raw_weights)

    # Weighted losses: negative weighted log probability
    loss_with = -np.sum(logp_with_result * weights[None, :], axis=1)
    loss_call_only = -np.sum(logp_call_only * weights[None, :], axis=1)
    loss_no_call = -np.sum(logp_no_call * weights[None, :], axis=1)

    # Counterfactual baseline (stronger)
    loss_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)

    # Margin and keep mask
    margins = loss_minus - loss_with
    keep = margins >= tau_filter

    return keep, margins
